response.sql: WITH rc AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), sh AS (SELECT region, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM rc) AS share FROM rc), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.cnt) AS total_clients, AVG(sh.share) AS average_share, AVG(sh.share - av.avg_share) AS average_excess_over_avg_share FROM sh CROSS JOIN av WHERE sh.share > av.avg_share
